items.question: How do we start?
items.answer: With the free plan: create your account, confirm your email and send your organization's details; we open its space once we have reviewed the request. For the other plans, send us a message on WhatsApp. Either way, we help you add your halaqat, teachers and students.

items.question: Do students need Telegram?
items.answer: No. Every message appears inside the app, and students can also turn on browser notifications. Telegram is one more option for those who use it.

items.question: Is our data separate from other schools?
items.answer: Yes. Each organization has its own private space. Other organizations cannot see your students, teachers or results.

items.question: What happens when a season ends?
items.answer: Hafiz saves the season's results as they are. If a student leaves or a halaqa changes later, the old season still shows the same numbers.

items.question: Which languages does Hafiz support?
items.answer: Hafiz supports several languages, including Arabic, English and Turkish. Each person chooses their own language.
